title: SWE-Tester: Training Open-Source LLMs for Issue Reproduction in Real-World Repositories
datasets: 41K curated PR instances; 23K fit 16K-token training limit
input_setting: buggy repository + issue; retrieved source/test context; separate oracle-localization evaluation
author_relationship_evidence: Paper v2 abstract links repository; README names paper and dataset, and exposes training/eval/context/harness modules.
license: No project-level software license verified; embedded SWT harness has a separate license
exact_models: SWE-Fixer-7B source retriever; Qwen3-Embedding-8B test reranker
weights_status: Main paper SFT checkpoints not verified. Inspected author 7B LoRA HF repository is public but contains only .gitattributes; adapter_config.json returns 404.
evaluation_route: eval/eval.py supports vLLM model_name and lora_request; README explicitly documents oracle-retrieval setting. Python3.12/uv; SWT Docker harness. Training recipes use 2-8 A100 or configurable single-device 7B.
blockers: Exact main SFT checkpoints and prepared inference data unresolved; public base weights are not paper-trained models
Author public HF repo name is not evidence of downloadable weights
Oracle versus retrieved-context experiments must be separated; paper tables reuse identical headline numbers and need config/result provenance
concept_fit: moderate: concepts can guide editing with matched localization, but fine-tuning is the paper's main contribution
recommendation: Promote source availability relative to initial scan, but defer as a budget-friendly base until exact trained checkpoints/data are released or verified.
